name: WF-316 — Offer Delivery Receipt → Seller Response / Timeout Controller

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const event=input.delivery_event??input.provider_event??input; const eventType=String(event.event_type??event.status??'').toLowerCase(); const dispatchId=event.dispatch_id??deal.dispatch_id; const dealId=deal.deal_id??deal.id; const leadId=deal.lead_id; const propertyId=deal.property_id; const dnc=deal.dnc===true; const blockers=Array.isArray(deal.blockers)?deal.blockers:[]; const responseText=String(event.response_text??event.inbound_message??deal.seller_response??'').trim(); const delivered=['delivered','sent','accepted'].includes(eventType); const failed=['failed','bounced','rejected','undeliverable'].includes(eventType); const responseReceived=['response_received','inbound_response','reply_received'].includes(eventType)||responseText.length>0; const timeout=['timeout','response_timeout','expired'].includes(eventType); let status='pending',next='WF-316',reason='awaiting provider/seller event'; if(dnc||blockers.length){status='blocked';next='WF-126';reason=dnc?'DNC protection':'active blockers';}else if(!dispatchId||!dealId){status='incomplete';next='WF-315';reason='dispatch/deal identity missing';}else if(responseReceived){status='seller_response_received';next='WF-317';reason='seller response captured';}else if(failed){status='delivery_failed';next='WF-315';reason='offer delivery failed';}else if(timeout){status='response_timeout';next='WF-318';reason='seller response window expired';}else if(delivered){status='delivered_awaiting_response';next='WF-317';reason='offer delivered; awaiting seller response';} return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-316',workflow_name:'Offer Delivery Receipt → Seller Response / Timeout Controller',status,reason,dispatch_id:dispatchId,seller_response:responseText||null,delivery_event:{event_type:eventType,delivered,failed,response_received:responseReceived,timeout},next_workflow:next,crm_activity:{activity_type:'offer_delivery_receipt',deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,status,dispatch_id:dispatchId,reason,seller_response:responseText||null}}}];
